name: zenit-week
description: Plan your week in Zenit Week: your agent adds and changes tasks in the open app, as if you clicked.
long_description:
Lets Claude read and change your week in [Zenit Week](https://zenitweek.com), the visual weekly planner. Your plans stay in your browser: the extension passes each request to the Zenit Week tab open in Chrome or Firefox on this computer, over 127.0.0.1 only, and the app does the work. Every change shows a toast and is one undo step.

After installing, open Zenit Week, turn on Settings > AI agents, and the first time Claude asks, check that the code matches and click Allow.

tools.name: open_week
tools.description: Show a week in the app (navigation, not an undo step).

tools.name: open_vision
tools.description: Show the Vision, the long-view mind map (navigation, not an undo step).

tools.name: add_task
tools.description: Add a task to the week in view.

tools.name: rename_task
tools.description: Rename a task.

tools.name: set_status
tools.description: Mark a task done, undone (reopens done or dropped), dropped (will not happen), unplanned or planned.

tools.name: set_priority
tools.description: Set a task priority (cascades to sub-tasks).

tools.name: set_horizon
tools.description: Set when an intention on the Vision is meant to happen: this year, in a few years, someday or none.

tools.name: set_days
tools.description: Replace the weekdays of a task.

tools.name: tick_task
tools.description: Record n repetitions of an Nx task (negative n reopens the last ones).

tools.name: set_comment
tools.description: Replace the comment of a task with Markdown (max 20000 chars; links http, https or mailto only).

tools.name: set_reusable
tools.description: Mark a task reusable (copied by transfer_reusable to the next week) or not.

tools.name: delete_task
tools.description: Delete a task at once.

tools.name: send_to_date
tools.description: Move a task out of this week to a date (YYYY-MM-DD), optionally repeating.

tools.name: transfer_unfinished
tools.description: Copy the previous week\.

tools.name: transfer_reusable
tools.description: Copy the previous week\.

tools.name: add_branch
tools.description: Add a branch (category) to the week in view.

tools.name: rename_branch
tools.description: Rename a branch of the record in view (a week or the Vision).

tools.name: delete_branch
tools.description: Delete a branch of the record in view with everything under it.

tools.name: undo
tools.description: Undo the last action in the app, whoever made it.

tools.name: redo
tools.description: Redo the last undone action.

tools.name: get_stats
tools.description: Completion statistics of the week in view.
